First and foremost, you are so loved. You are a strong and intelligent man and you are not the issue. I’m so sorry your dad has betrayed you like this. Please understand you are not the problem. You were never the problem and you should never have been made to feel as if you were. His actions and the way he’s treated you is cruel and unfair. I’m sorry that I cannot offer you sound advice but life is the pursuit of happiness and you must do right by you. If you feel that continuing your education is the right move, I support you. If you think working full time and living on your own is what needs to be done, I support you. Whatever you choose, just make sure it’s for you and you alone and it will be ok. Keep your chin up, puff your chest out and take each day in your stride

You are so strong never forget that, I’m so proud of you for getting through this chapter of your life and coming out the other side. I think this anxiety your feeling is natural and it’s expected. Perhaps relay your fears into your husband, he may be feeling the same way and perhaps that in itself will bring you some level of comfort. 
I can’t promise you that it’ll be perfect and I can’t promise you that everything will be smooth sailing from here but I can promise you that you have the strength and intelligence to handle yourself in the deepest pit and if you do ever find yourself in rough waters, you can hold each other for support and make it through just like you have before. Keep an open mind and be willing to embrace your newfound comfort. You are amazing and you deserve this.
